'''Red Sword Flight''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] made up of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] flying [[StealthX]] fighters, led by Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. It consisted of three [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]] paired with three [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knights]].

During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], they were trailing the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']] using the tracking device planted on [[Darth Caedus]]'s cape. Upon learning that Caedus was not aboard ''Anakin Solo'' but was instead in a [[TIE Reconnaissance Fighter|cloaked starfighter]] hovering nearby, they revised their plan and Skywalker went after Caedus.

Skywalker was about to fire the killing blow when he suddenly discovered [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana's]]&mdash;the daughter of Caedus and [[Hapan]] [[Queen Mother]] [[Tenel Ka Djo]]&mdash;presence inside with Caedus. Deciding that [[Death/Legends|killing]] Caedus along with an innocent was not worth it, Skywalker ordered a retreat as the ''Anakin Solo'' and a complement of starfighters arrived to Caedus's rescue.
